exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.updateSubtitle: Change how {agentName} runs on pull requests
exportWizard.updateRepoHint: Updating an existing installation — switch repository to update a different one.
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.bundleSizeNote: Adds ~{size} of runner bundle to the repository.

exportWizard.providerBlocked: This agent runs on {provider}. The CI runner only executes OpenRouter agents — switch the agent's provider to OpenRouter to export it.
exportWizard.repoClaimed: {repo} already runs {agent} in CI. One agent per repository.
exportWizard.runnerMissing: The CI runner bundle has not been built.
exportWizard.postAsHint: Only GitHub review yields a verdict on the pull request.

secrets.openrouter: Your OpenRouter key — the runner reads it from the repo's Actions secrets.
secrets.githubToken: Auto-provided by Actions — nothing to do.

exportWizard.needHelp: Need help? See the <link>GitHub Actions secrets docs →</link>
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.blockMergeInfo: To block merges: set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then add a required status check in the repo's GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App needed.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.emptyBody: Deploy this agent to run automatically on every pull request in a repo's CI pipeline.
ciTab.failOnDesc: Exit non-zero when a finding at or above this severity lands. Pair with a required status check to block merges.
ciTab.driftNotice: CI still runs the previously exported policy ({exported}) until you re-export this agent.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
